candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Overview
verified_facts: OS Terrain 50 is a lower-resolution DTM designed for landscape visualisation and analysis over large areas.
Grid data uses regular 50m post spacing.
Grid data has been verified to 4m RMSE.
Product is updated annually in July.
semantic_limits: 4m RMSE is product-level accuracy metadata and is not a parcel-specific confidence interval.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Technical Specification - Grid data
verified_facts: ASCII grid is a raster grid.
Each height value is calculated from the centre of each 50m by 50m pixel.
Each row contains 200 pixels and height values are supplied to the nearest 0.1m.
semantic_limits: The specification does not prescribe an equal-weight parcel aggregation statistic for polygons smaller than a 50m cell.

candidates.name: Index polygons spatial data (INSPIRE)
verified_facts: INSPIRE polygons show position and indicative extent of registered freehold property.
The extent of land in a registered title cannot be established from INSPIRE polygons alone.
semantic_limits: Exact HMLR ID matching does not make the polygon an exact legal boundary.

candidates.name: Technical guidance for GML files
verified_facts: HMLR data is captured against British National Grid.
BNG to WGS84 conversion may shift some features by up to 15m.
semantic_limits: WGS84 is display-only in this measurement chain.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) - 1m
verified_facts: DTM covers about 99% of England at 1m resolution.
semantic_limits: Dataset metadata is not a parcel-specific accuracy guarantee.
